summary.text: Steve Cwodzinski is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota Senate for District 49, first elected in 2016 and re-elected in 2020 and 2022.
His official Senate page lists committee assignments including Education Policy, Education Finance, Elections, and State and Local Government, and shows him in his third term.

sources.title: Senator Steve Cwodzinski (49, DFL) - Minnesota Senate
